question: In a certain code language, MODERN is written as RONMED. How will PERIODIC be written as in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

**LOGIC: Letters of word are coded as reverse alphabetical order.**

MODERN is written as RONMED

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e079a72565b499e9f704652ca2142cda6e28f4fb0b4a9dd69a566c03e6c7aff.png] 

Similarly,

**PERIODIC =?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00a3238ef3913dc0efcbe6b0666128dce2f0c1abab67315246e2c33918fb235f.png] 

Hence, **PERIODIC will be written as RPOIIEDC.**
